{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically too high starting at day 4, diverging from true outcomes by 0.5-3.0 points",
    "True outcomes exhibit steady 1-2 point daily decline each day from day 4-33 while model shows flat or slightly rising prices",
    "Sentiment turning negative (value < 0) correlates with faster price declines in true outcomes vs model",
    "Model fails to capture the momentum reversal around day 8-10 where prices begin accelerating downward",
    "Forecast lag: true outcomes lead by 1-3 days, model responds to stale price levels",
    "Mean reversion bias: model overestimates persistence at high prices, underestimates correction at low prices",
    "Sentiment strength matters: weak positive sentiment (0.33-0.67) correlates with model forecasts being 2-4 points too high"
] }
